title: Arrival screen's question count matches the walk

requirements.text: The number of questions the arrival screen announces equals the number of question items the walk then presents
requirements.check: Replay a reply whose items block has 0 questions and one with 2; compare the arrival text with the items walked

text: Likely cause, not yet confirmed: the arrival screen counts a snapshot of pending; dropPast (the moved mark, resent on every reconnect) can drop items while it shows. 01:42:32: 'Five updates, one question' then reconnect at 01:43, and no walk. Fix in 0.1.456589: ArrivalScreen counts live pending (WalkPlan.arrivalNow, unit-tested); dropPast logs 'dropped N past items (Q questions)'. Confirm from the bridge log.
